 Jamie Foxx, 58, and girlfriend Alyce Huckstepp, 31, welcome their first child together, his third 
 By 
 Riley Cardoza 
 Published 
 Nov. 4, 2026, 12:36 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Jamie Foxx is back in action.
 The actor’s girlfriend, Alyce Huckstep, has given birth to their first child together , his third, sources confirmed to People .
 The Oscar winner, 58, is already the father of two daughters — Corinne, 32, and Anelise, 17 — whom he welcomed with ex-girlfriends Connie Kline and Kristin Grannis, respectively.

 News broke in May that the actor’s partner was “several months” pregnant with her first baby.
 Huckstepp debuted her bump later that same month while out and about in Los Angeles.
 The fitness instructor has been romantically linked to Foxx since May 2022.

 The duo have had a tumultuous relationship since they were first spotted packing on the PDA on a yacht in Cannes.
 In 2023, Foxx suffered a stroke — and People reported that “loyal” Huckstepp was “there for” the comedian while he navigated the health scare.
 “Alyce is a sweetie, a great girl,” a source told the outlet.
 8 
 Foxx (pictured above in October 2024) was first spotted with Huckstepp in 2022. HEM / BACKGRID 
 8 
 The duo (pictured above in August 2025) have largely kept their romance out of the spotlight. JAST / BACKGRID 
 After three years of keeping their romance out of the limelight, Page Six confirmed the pair had broken up in January 2025.
 We reported they had last been seen together on an October 2024 Mexico getaway — the same year Foxx declared he was “cured” of dating white women in a comedy special.
 “No more white girls. I’m serious!” he said in “What Had Happened Was.”
 8 
 Page Six reported in January 2025 that the pair (pictured above in September 2024) broke up. BACKGRID 
 8 
 Foxx and Huckstepp were next seen together in August 2025 in Los Angeles. JAST / BACKGRID 
 By August 2025, Foxx and Huckstepp had reunited and were seen together in Los Angeles.
 While the latter’s past dating history is not known, Foxx was previously in a six-year relationship with Katie Holmes .
 The former couple called it quits in the summer of 2019.
